caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular structure with a triangular pediment at the top, resembling a tomb or mausoleum. The structure has two rectangular doors or panels, each positioned side by side, and each with a small circular keyhole or knob. In the foreground, there is a detailed cast iron fence with vertical and horizontal elements designed to resemble branches or twigs, with irregular, organic shapes and multiple protrusions. The fence has sturdy posts at each end, similarly styled to look like thick, upright branches, and a central double gate with a latch mechanism. Behind the tomb, trees and shrubs with leafy, pointed tops are visible, and clouds fill the sky above, all rendered in fine linework. The drawing is presented in black and white with intricate shading and hatching, creating depth and detail. At the bottom center, there is a label reading “CAST IRON TOMB ENCLOSURE.” Measurements are indicated along the right side of the drawing, showing a height of 54 inches.
title: Iron Fence around Tomb
